nodes.label: Pocket Node (offline AI network node)
nodes.rationale: Fork of Google AI Edge Gallery bridging on-device LiteRT inference to an embedded Ktor HTTP server so the phone's offline LLMs serve the local WiFi network instead of PC GPU or paid cloud APIs.

nodes.label: Per-Model Inference Mutex (serverMutexMap)
nodes.rationale: Serializes concurrent HTTP inference per model to prevent native SIGABRT/SIGSEGV LiteRT-LM crashes; AtomicBoolean guards against double coroutine resume.
